items.title: T.J. Hockenson: Gets into end zone against Indy
items.text:
Hockenson caught four of five targets for 35 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts.

items.title: Jordan Addison: Just two catches in Sunday's win
items.text:
Addison caught two of three targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts. He added three yards on his lone carry.

items.title: Jordan Mason: Leading rusher in return
items.text:
Mason carried the ball 15 times for 68 yards in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts. He failed to catch either of his two targets.

items.title: Drake London: Paces pass catchers in win
items.text:
London secured seven of 10 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in the Falcons' 29-20 win over the 49ers on Sunday.

items.title: Christian McCaffrey: Navigates injury in Week 7 loss
items.text:
McCaffrey rushed seven times for 39 yards and a touchdown and brought in six of seven targets for 61 yards in the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday.

items.title: Kyler Murray: Does just enough against Indy
items.text:
Murray completed 14 of 24 passes for 150 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts. He added 39 rushing yards on five carries.
